This is a publication-order burden, not an absent interface: the three-property preview at lines 454–460 is explicit, and the construction route already permits skipping. More route links do not change that first complete reading. A construction-first order would make each later supplier calculation answer a concrete dependency.
feedback.advice: Use the existing ingredient preview as the main contract, with the exact one-sided promise and all-input cap conditions beside it. Bring the complete §4 board, predicate and local tests before the long analytic derivation. Complete the quantum and planted reductions using the stated contract, then discharge its detailed supplier proofs in a separately named full-proof part. In the opening, retain the mL versus square-root-m mechanism and move the fixed-time event and numerical r choice to the lower-bound proof map. Consolidate the overlapping reading guide, mechanism preview and dependency index into one short role-based map with separately named proof destinations.
